description: Lightning takes one oxidation stage off a copper golem (#114, #162): an oxidized golem draws its statue chance from its random every tick; a bolt strikes it on several ticks but takes only one stage, after which it is weathered (a command reads the stage back as a gold block, and no diamond block for a second stage), draws no more and sets a new weathering time.

actions.command: execute if entity @e[type=minecraft:copper_golem,nbt={weather_state:"weathered"}] run setblock 2 -60 1 minecraft:gold_block
execute if entity @e[type=minecraft:copper_golem,nbt={weather_state:"exposed"}] run setblock 2 -60 3 minecraft:diamond_block
